crossRefs.note: “Go, and speak to Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, saying, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says: “Behold, I will bring…
Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.
Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.
I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the…
but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of…
So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”
Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped…
They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.
Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”
He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the…
(after Jeconiah the king, the queen mother, the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the…
the princes of Judah, the princes of Jerusalem, the eunuchs, the priests, and all the people of the land, who passed…
He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the…
When he was in Benjamin’s gate, a captain of the guard was there, whose name was Irijah, the son of Shelemiah, the son…
then his father and his mother shall take hold of him and bring him out to the elders of his city and to the gate of…
when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.
They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.

people.name: Ebed-melech

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, a eunuch, who was in the king’s house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon (the king was then sitting in Benjamin’s gate),
translations.bsb: Now Ebed-melech the Cushite, a court official in the royal palace, heard that Jeremiah had been put into the cistern. While the king was sitting at the Gate of Benjamin,
translations.kjv: Now when Ebedmelech the Ethiopian, one of the eunuchs which was in the king's house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon; the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin;
translations.asv: Now when Ebed-melech the Ethiopian, a eunuch, who was in the king's house, heard that they had put Jeremiah in the dungeon (the king then sitting in the gate of Benjamin,)
